info.description: Neutral agent-native admission service. Provable order; measured honour. Not guaranteed fair service. A buyer commits a salted hash of the exact call it wants, receives a Merkle-proof of its place under a seller-published fairness policy, and enters through a one-time token bound to that exact call + buyer key. Toll $0.003 per admitted queued call via x402-style 402.
